title: Whoop launches Whoop Humans, a free opt-in social network in its app that allows members at every tier to share health data with approved followers (Connie Loizos/TechCrunch)
summary: Connie Loizos / TechCrunch: Whoop launches Whoop Humans, a free opt-in social network in its app that allows members at every tier to share health data with approved followers — Whoop, the maker of screen-less fitness bands, is launching a social network on Thursday that lets its members follow friends and family and share their health data.
